entities.summary: Fujiwara no Akisuke was a waka poet and nobleman active in the Heian period Japan. One of his poems is included in the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu. A member of the Fujiwara clan, he was also known as Sakyō no Daibu Akisuke. His father was Fujiwara no Akisue and his son was Fujiwara no Kiyosuke.
